verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS product that also ships a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Stripe Invoicing, its CLI, or its MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
